steps.name: environment
steps.description: Validate Node.js (>=18) and npm presence, ensure jq is available (install if missing), verify sudo non-interactive capability, and persist CI-friendly NODE_ENV and PORT defaults safely into /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh. This step writes an unevaluated heredoc so shells evaluate ${NODE_ENV:-development} and ${PORT:-3000} at runtime (avoids writing empty values). Treat npm<8 as a recommendation only (warn). Idempotent and non-interactive.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKDIR="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/responsive-todo-list-application-236634-236649/backend"
# ensure workspace exists before cd
[ -d "$WORKDIR" ] || { echo "ERROR: workspace $WORKDIR missing" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: node not found" >&2; exit 3; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: npm not found" >&2; exit 4; }
NODE_VER_RAW=$(node -p "process.versions.node")
NODE_MAJOR=$(printf "%s" "$NODE_VER_RAW" | cut -d. -f1)
if ! printf "%s" "$NODE_MAJOR" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+$'; then echo "ERROR: unexpected Node version format: $NODE_VER_RAW" >&2; exit 5; fi
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 18 ]; then echo "ERROR: Node.js $NODE_VER_RAW detected; require >=18" >&2; exit 6; fi
NPM_VER_RAW=$(npm -v)
NPM_MAJOR=$(printf "%s" "$NPM_VER_RAW" | cut -d. -f1 || echo 0)
if printf "%s" "$NPM_MAJOR" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+$' && [ "$NPM_MAJOR" -lt 8 ]; then echo "WARNING: npm $NPM_VER_RAW detected; npm>=8 recommended but not required" >&2; fi
# ensure jq available idempotently; minimal retries for transient apt issues
if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
    sudo apt-get update -qq || true
    sudo apt-get install -y -qq jq || { echo "ERROR: failed to install jq" >&2; exit 8; }
  else
    echo "ERROR: jq missing and sudo not available non-interactively" >&2; exit 9
  fi
fi
# safely persist unevaluated defaults so runtime shells expand them; verify sudo -n first
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/node_env.sh
if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
  sudo tee "$PROFILE" >/dev/null <<'EOF'
# persisted by automated setup: NODE_ENV and PORT defaults (evaluated at shell runtime)
export NODE_ENV="${NODE_ENV:-development}"
export PORT="${PORT:-3000}"
EOF
  sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE"
else
  echo "WARNING: cannot write $PROFILE: sudo requires a password; skipping global env persistence" >&2
fi
# inform about effective values in current shell (do not assume written file took effect)
export NODE_ENV="${NODE_ENV:-development}"
export PORT="${PORT:-3000}"
echo "NODE_OK: node=$NODE_VER_RAW npm=$NPM_VER_RAW NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV PORT=$PORT"
exit 0

steps.name: scaffold-project
steps.description: If no package.json exists in workspace, create a minimal CRA app using the preinstalled global create-react-app. Do NOT scaffold into a non-empty workspace to avoid clobbering: abort with a clear error if non-dot files exist. Add 'serve' to devDependencies only if missing. Require network fallback via ALLOW_NETWORK=1 environment variable; otherwise refuse to attempt npx. Set CI=1 and SKIP_PREFLIGHT_CHECK=1 to avoid interactive prompts and speed up scaffolding.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKDIR="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/responsive-todo-list-application-236634-236649/backend"
# check workspace exists first
[ -d "$WORKDIR" ] || { echo "ERROR: workspace $WORKDIR missing" >&2; exit 2; }
cd "$WORKDIR"
# if package.json exists, skip
[ -f package.json ] && { echo "SCAFFOLD_SKIPPED: package.json exists"; exit 0; }
# refuse to scaffold into non-empty workspace (except dotfiles)
shopt -s nullglob
files=("$WORKDIR"/*)
# count non-dot files
count=0
for f in "${files[@]}"; do [[ $(basename "$f") = .* ]] || count=$((count+1)); done
if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then echo "ERROR: workspace not empty; aborting scaffold to avoid clobbering" >&2; exit 3; fi
TMPLOG=/tmp/scaffold.log
export CI=1
export SKIP_PREFLIGHT_CHECK=1
# prefer preinstalled create-react-app; npx fallback only if ALLOW_NETWORK=1
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  create-react-app . --use-npm >"$TMPLOG" 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: create-react-app failed; see $TMPLOG" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$TMPLOG" >&2 || true; exit 5; }
else
  if [ "${ALLOW_NETWORK:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    npx create-react-app@latest . --use-npm >"$TMPLOG" 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: npx create-react-app failed; see $TMPLOG" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$TMPLOG" >&2 || true; exit 6; }
  else
    echo "ERROR: create-react-app global binary not found and network fallback disabled (set ALLOW_NETWORK=1 to permit npx)" >&2; exit 7
  fi
fi
# ensure package.json exists
[ -f package.json ] || { echo "ERROR: scaffolding did not produce package.json; see $TMPLOG" >&2; exit 8; }
# ensure serve in devDependencies: add only if missing
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));p.devDependencies=p.devDependencies||{};if(!p.devDependencies.serve){p.devDependencies.serve='latest';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));console.log('ADDED_SERVE')}" > /tmp/scaffold_node_out 2>&1 || true
# run npm install for added devDependency only if package-lock absent; actual install will be in deps-003 step
echo "SCAFFOLD_OK"
exit 0

steps.name: testing-setup
steps.description: Create a minimal Jest-style sanity test and run tests once in CI mode. Detect available test runner: prefer node_modules/.bin/jest; if package.json has a 'test' script, run it in CI; otherwise skip tests with message. Compatible with CRA and will not falsely assume react-scripts presence for non-CRA projects.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKDIR="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/responsive-todo-list-application-236634-236649/backend"
[ -d "$WORKDIR" ] || { echo "ERROR: workspace $WORKDIR missing" >&2; exit 2; }
cd "$WORKDIR"
mkdir -p src/__tests__
cat > src/__tests__/sanity.test.js <<'JS'
test('sanity', ()=>{expect(1+1).toBe(2)})
JS
LOG=/tmp/test.log
# prefer local jest if available
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/jest ]; then
  CI=true ./node_modules/.bin/jest --runInBand --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: jest tests failed; see $LOG" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2 || true; exit 16; }
else
  # if package.json has a test script, run npm test in CI mode
  if node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); process.exit(p.scripts&&p.scripts.test?0:1)"; then
    CI=true npm test --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: npm test failed; see $LOG" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2 || true; exit 17; }
  else
    echo "TEST_SKIPPED: no test runner or test script found" >"$LOG"
  fi
fi
echo "TEST_OK"
exit 0

steps.name: build-and-validate
steps.description: Build production bundle (npm run build) and start a lightweight static server to validate the built site responds. Prefer local node_modules/.bin/serve, else global serve. Start serve in a new process group when possible, guard PGID/SERVE_PID before cleanup, poll for any 2xx response on / and fallback to /index.html if needed. Provide logs on failure and ensure clean shutdown.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKDIR="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/responsive-todo-list-application-236634-236649/backend"
[ -d "$WORKDIR" ] || { echo "ERROR: workspace $WORKDIR missing" >&2; exit 2; }
cd "$WORKDIR"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo "ERROR: package.json missing" >&2; exit 3; }
# load persisted env if available (non-fatal)
[ -f /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh ] && . /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh || true
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
# ensure build script exists
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(!p.scripts||!p.scripts.build){console.error('ERROR: package.json missing build script'); process.exit(1); }" || { echo "ERROR: build script missing" >&2; exit 14; }
# build capturing logs
npm run build --silent > /tmp/build.log 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: build failed; see /tmp/build.log" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' /tmp/build.log >&2 || true; exit 15; }
# choose serve binary
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/serve ]; then
  SERVE_BIN="./node_modules/.bin/serve"
elif command -v serve >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  SERVE_BIN="$(command -v serve)"
else
  echo "ERROR: 'serve' binary not found locally or globally; ensure 'serve' is installed" >&2; exit 16
fi
LOG=/tmp/serve_out.log
# start server: prefer setsid but verify success
if command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  setsid "$SERVE_BIN" -s build -l 0.0.0.0:$PORT >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
else
  "$SERVE_BIN" -s build -l 0.0.0.0:$PORT >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
fi
SERVE_PID=$!
sleep 0.2
if ! kill -0 "$SERVE_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: serve process died immediately; tail $LOG" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2 || true; exit 17; fi
# determine PGID safely
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$SERVE_PID" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ' || true)
cleanup() {
  if [ -n "${PGID:-}" ] && [ "$PGID" != "" ]; then
    pkill -TERM -g "$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; pkill -KILL -g "$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true
  else
    if [ -n "${SERVE_PID:-}" ]; then kill -TERM "$SERVE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; kill -KILL "$SERVE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
# wait for server (max 45s)
RETRIES=45
SLEEP=1
OK=0
for i in $(seq 1 $RETRIES); do
  HTTP=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" || true)
  if [ -n "$HTTP" ] && [ "$HTTP" != "" ] && [[ "$HTTP" =~ ^2[0-9][0-9]$ ]]; then OK=1; break; fi
  # try index.html as fallback
